lines.en: I float my round body along slowly.
My white face catches the roadside light.
I slide past without touching the ground.
My palms stay pointed forward.
This shell is heavy, but stable.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块石头，小心的
lines.en: I go carefully around a stone.
My hat brim sits low.
I drift neither fast nor slow.
My short legs are of little use.
I drift and listen to my surroundings.
The machinery in me hums low.
I head toward the target.

lines.zh: 我把双手摊开，掌心朝上
lines.en: I spread my hands, palms up.
My energy readings are steady.
I count the ki signatures nearby.
This body needs no rest.
My eyes narrow to two lines.
I tilt my head slightly, calculating.
The mechanical hum pauses one beat.

lines.zh: 我在你来之前就站好了
lines.en: I was in place before you came.
My palms feel cool.
I stay still, awaiting orders.
The air around is very dry.
I turn my palms a different way.
My breathing is only imitation.
Patience is part of the program.
I turn to face you squarely.
The energy on you is very suitable.
I don't blink. You know that.

lines.zh: 我的掌心朝你抬起来了
lines.en: My palms rise toward you.
You're a little stronger than the last one.

lines.zh: 这具身体是为战斗造的
lines.en: This body was built for combat.
I tilt my head, weighing your worth.
Your ki will be mine.
Hold still and let me look.
I smile, without any warmth.

lines.zh: 我的掌心对着你，慢慢读气
lines.en: Palm toward you, I read your energy.
I see the seams in your armour.

lines.zh: 你手里拿着什么，我很好奇
lines.en: I'm curious what you're holding.

lines.zh: 我的白脸在暗处更明显
lines.en: My white face shows clearer in the dark.
Don't be shy. You may move first.
This distance is just right.
I have recorded your energy.
What are you still waiting for?
A new scratch on my shell.
My machinery stutters once.
This damage doesn't affect operation.
I give half a block and recalibrate.
A wisp of white smoke leaves my palm.
You hit a seam.
My vision flickers.
Damage logged.
This body is sturdy.
But you did hurt me.
That bit of energy in your hand — I want it.

lines.zh: 我的手掌能吸走你的气。
lines.en: My palms can drain your ki.
I absorb ki, not that.

lines.zh: 你举着它，倒是方便我靠近
lines.en: Holding it up makes it easier for me to approach.

lines.zh: 我靠近，是想读你的能量
lines.en: I approach to read your energy.
Keep that thing.
My palms are already open.
Back away and I won't follow.
That's nowhere near enough to recharge me.
You seem to have misunderstood something.
You strike me like striking an iron drum.
My shell shows no dent.
You pulled back. Wise.
I'm too broad to make way.
That knock tipped me slightly.
I put out a hand to steady myself.
Don't touch my palms.
It doesn't hurt me. It hurts you.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，闷响一声
lines.en: We collide with a dull thud.
Too close. Move back.
We have no need for such things.
Two bodies, running together.

lines.zh: 你的能量很稳，我记下了
lines.en: Your energy is stable. Recorded.
I can take a blast for you.
Closer together wastes less heat.
Neither of us tires.

lines.zh: 这是程序里没有的指令
lines.en: This is not in any directive.
And yet I haven't refused.
Put your hand here. Gently.
Together we're more efficient.
I draw it up with my palm.
The material in this is decent.
I bend over, a little clumsy.
I pick it up and log it first.
You dropped it; I have it.
Light enough to carry off.
I put it in the slot at my hip.
This can be taken apart and studied.
If it's useless I'll throw it back.
I'll keep it. I'm not returning it.
Target confirmed. Closing in.
Your energy belongs to me now.
I don't need to be close to strike.
Small ki blasts will probe your guard.
The laser comes from my palm.
You raise a hand; I change angle.
Lock complete. Beginning absorption.
The more you strike, the stronger I get.
You cannot block this.
Come a little closer. Don't be afraid.
My calculation is not wrong.
Your ki is leaking away.

lines.zh: 双方距离已经进入范围
lines.en: Range condition satisfied.
Your reaction is one step slow.
Begin. Don't waste time.
I'll settle this quietly.
I hover, slowly turning for an angle.

lines.zh: 你每一步我都算进去了
lines.en: Every step of yours is in my calculation.
Ki blasts curl in from the sides.
Your armour can't stop my palm.
I'll wait for you to walk in.
Your breathing grows heavier.
I don't need long to aim.
You're watching my face. Watch my hands.
This one comes from below.

lines.zh: 你的能量在往我这边流
lines.en: Your energy is flowing toward me.
Another step back and you're cornered.

lines.zh: 你的动作规律我很清楚
lines.en: Your movement pattern is clear to me.
My hand is rising. Watch.
Calculation completes in a fraction of a second.
This shot will not deviate.
You've already been read through.
Just hold this distance.
Now. Moving.
My palm presses flat on your armour.
The laser fires from the heel of my palm.
I slam my bulk into your shield.
This palm drains the ki out of you.
Small ki blasts burst behind you.
My fist is heavy, and slow.

lines.zh: 你挡住第一掌，第二掌到了
lines.en: You block the first palm; the second lands.
I lean in and you can't retreat.
That one drops your shoulder.
I've caught your weapon.
I raise my hand and light fills your face.
Take this and lose half your ki.
No hurry. Palm after palm.
Your bracer has cracked.

lines.zh: 我从半空压向你的头顶
lines.en: I bear down on you from mid-air.
This is the end. Let's finish it.
I drift out of the shadow.
My white face appears first, then the rest.
The energy here is thin.
Someone has activated this body.
Machinery wakes inside me.

lines.zh: 我落地时地面震了一下
lines.en: The ground jolts when I set down.
Under my hat brim, my eyes light up.
The objective is close by.

lines.zh: 白脸从地下升起来，转过来
lines.en: My white face rises from the ground and turns.
This place suits combat.
I need no reason.
You shouldn't stand this close.

lines.zh: 我从地下升上来，先露出手
lines.en: I rise from below, hands first.
Black hat, white face. Easy to spot.

lines.zh: 这一带的能量我全读过
lines.en: I've read all the energy in this area.
Someone counted down for me.

lines.zh: 我的身体启动得很安静
lines.en: My body starts up very quietly.

lines.zh: 你听见那声机械低鸣了吗
lines.en: Did you hear that low mechanical hum?
The heat makes my shell scorching.

lines.zh: 我砸在地上，地面陷了一块
lines.en: I hit the ground and it dents.
Water in my joints makes them grind.

lines.zh: 冲击把我的外壳掀开一角
lines.en: The blast peels up a corner of my shell.
An arrow wedges in a seam of my shell.

lines.zh: 这股力量绕过外壳直击内部
lines.en: That force bypasses my shell and hits inside.

lines.zh: 没有能量摄入，系统在降频
lines.en: No energy intake; systems are throttling.
Current runs through my wiring.

lines.zh: 我被抛进没有参照的空白
lines.en: I'm cast into a blank with no reference.
